A New Chapter Begins Official Launch of Shivanisharma Foundation🦋 ​“Small Step,Big Impact” This philosophy is at the core of everything we do. 9th August marked the grand official launch of the Shivani Sharma Foundation, standing united on stage with our leadership, team, dedicated volunteers, and promising young students holding their new laptops. ​This event was more than just a celebration; it was a firm commitment to long-term social change, digital literacy, and community welfare. Through our drive, we equipped 50 young minds with laptops for their digital education and provided sports clothes to promote holistic development among children. ​We are also thrilled to announce that our official website is now live! 🌐 www.shivanisharmafoundation.org This meaningful initiative dedicated to empowering students through education and technology at the Laptop Distribution Ceremony 2026, organised by Shivanisharms Foundation , held at Ravindra Natya Mandir, Mumbai. Manisha Tupe - Trustee, Shri Siddhivinayak Ganpati Temple Trust Our Mission : The Shivanisharma Foundation was founded on a simple belief: Inequality Is Not Inevitable, it can Be Changed. We envision a world where every woman knows her worth, every child has access to education, healthcare is within reach and many more. Through our work, we strive to create a future built on dignity, empowerment, and hope for all. 50 Laptops. 50 Futures. Small Step. Big Impact.
